name: compagnon
description: Companion pane: automatic model switching without losing the cache, context, 7-day plan usage, stalled processes, errors, repository state.

projects.title: Followed repositories
projects.description: Absolute paths of the git repositories to follow, separated by ";". Empty: the session's project only.

showBand.title: Band above the prompt
showBand.description: One line of figures (model, advisor, cost, context, agents) above the prompt. Uncheck to keep the pane only.

classify.title: Classify unrecognised requests with a model
classify.description: A request the keywords do not recognise is classified by a Haiku call (about 1 s and a few hundred tokens) instead of going to Opus. Uncheck to keep the keywords only.

coldGuardTokens.title: Cold cache guard threshold
coldGuardTokens.description: Context size (tokens, e.g. 150000 or 150k) above which a send on a cold cache asks first. 0: never.
